name: execute_code input shapes
description: Covers execute_code's return forms (expression, trailing return, trailing expression, void, a return inside if and inside try), the result shapes (anonymous type, dictionary, list, over 100 items, Vector3, GameObject, Component, null, a 40 KB string, a self-containing list, nesting past the depth limit, enum, Type, decimal, a destroyed object, a throwing ToString), language features (using directives before statements, a local function with and without static or an access modifier, and inside a declared type's method, no local-function hint for a method inside a declared type, LINQ and lambdas, a throwing lambda, foreach over Dictionary Keys, Values and SortedDictionary, generics, unqualified Object and Math, reflection, comments, a 1000-character line), declared types (nested, redeclared, a declaration with a trailing statement, several statics assigned in one input), runtime and compiler errors with their position, statement and stack trace, types from RocketLib, BroMakerLib, Swap Bros Mod and a class-only script, and a call that holds the main thread past 9 seconds and returns, one that holds it past the 9s budget and 2s grace and is reported still running, followed by a trivial call. A block comment right before a trailing return, after a statement and as the first thing in the input, compiles. A generic class declared by execute_code runs when used in the same input and in a later one, its field named from a sibling class of that input included. A generic method runs when called in the same input and in a later one, a lambda in one included, capturing or not, and a call to itself or to another generic method of the same input with its own type arguments or from elsewhere, in execute_code and in a script; one with other type arguments from inside its own body, or a virtual or interface one with fixed type arguments from the compile that declares it, is refused and names the rewrites, which run. A declaration that was refused does not stay declared: calling it says the type does not exist, an earlier declaration of the name stays, and its input's using directives stay out. Naming JsonConvert works at the first naming in a new Evaluator, in statements and in a declaration, with its unloadable overloads missing and reading their attributes throwing; other library types do too, and JsonConvert of an anonymous type and of a generic class with a public field, and the fields of an anonymous type, read by reflection, answer. An anonymous type with the names of an earlier one and other types compiles. The same alias with another target fails with CS1537 and a line saying to pick another name, leaving the earlier one in force, the preamble's Object alias included. A delegate declared again replaces the earlier one, as a class does. A using directive is replayed after the Evaluator is rebuilt for an unloaded script and after a compiler crash, a crash is built once and not retried, a CS0584 carries its Cause lines in execute_code and a script compile while the mod's nested-type import fix is taken away and put back, a caller error in a request is answered at once under its own id, without the Internal error prefix, over a second connection that opens with the hello and its token, and a reply past 64 KB carrying surrogate pairs and BMP characters comes back whole. Six real calls that once failed to compile: Harmony Unpatch as a statement and as the last statement, Harmony's patch registry, a LevelSelectionController static property and constant, and JsonConvert. Constants and enums are covered by script-constants.json. Needs RocketLib, BroMakerLib with Cobro installed and Swap Bros Mod. Its first step unloads the script an earlier failed run left loaded; its later steps unload it and check nothing is left, and its cleanup runs the first step again, which unloads the scripts and puts the import fix back and removes the crash counter if a failed run left them changed, then rebuilds the Evaluator through a compiler crash, since an Evaluator that imported Dictionary<int,int>.KeyCollection.Enumerator while the fix was away keeps that broken import after the fix is back.
